status: Source proposal. Not runtime, browser, CI or human visual acceptance.
summary: Normative UX rule prose moves from the legacy /token-standards/ page to the new /standards/ page (UX standards). Token value tables stay on /tokens/ (Design tokens). The legacy route and its catalog anchors resolve on /tokens/; its rule anchors resolve on /standards/ as aliases inside the matching sections, without duplicated rule text.
valueSource: docs/src/theme-builder/definitions.json through tokenDefinitions; the standards page reads only the values its rules name and links to the /tokens/ tables.

anchorMap.content: CSS variable usage, theme file shape and source responsibilities.
4 px rhythm, inset reuse for margin and padding, density and reflow rules.
Surface roles, functional boundaries and shadow use. State-axis prose moved to interaction-states.
Symmetric easing, positive durations, reduced motion and atomic palette switching. Focus prose moved to focus; the duration table stays on /tokens/.
Stacking order separate from shadow elevation.
Scrim and 1 px central blur, Tooltip included while visible, Toast and Notification excluded, Drawer/Modal whole-background blur. Overlay token values stay on /tokens/.

ruleChanges.after: Latest direct human GenUI decision for this project: minimum 12, standard 14, reading 16 CSS px, weight at least 300. Global instruction files are unchanged.

ruleChanges.before: Input slot radius derived by concentric subtraction.
ruleChanges.after: One shared general radius (default from radius-md) for every size family; input and slot use exactly the same radius when edited. The nested content-box size formula is unchanged.

ruleChanges.before: Selection visual profile 32/40/50 px; Pill 32/40/48 px.
ruleChanges.after: Compact selection, Pill, Slider, list and Cascader rows 32/40/48 px; descriptions grow. Implementation of profile values belongs to the owning packages.
Current rules reference UX standards; values reference Design tokens.

unchanged: Tab-only central focus mode, ringless type-specific indicators and the narrow forced-colors CanvasText fallback
Overlay scope, central Cubic motion and shell/panel/field role colors
Eight component documentation sections, frozen 59 packages and the pending live-host decision
history: Historical logs, evidence paths and receipts that name Token standards or token-standards.astro remain unchanged and labelled history.
dependencies: docs/src/data/documentation-rules.json must list /standards/ under a page kind (owned by another package).
Navigation groups and the /token-standards/ redirect are owned by the navigation package.
Register the Turkish dictionary if locale dictionaries are not discovered automatically.
